correctness.rationale: The 2^m complementary two-symbol blocks each contribute at least one greedy matched symbol to a target, and there are exactly 2^m zeros, establishing shortest absent length 2^m+1. For any orientation b of h blocks, a target of length h+1 is absent iff its i-th adjacent target pair is not the i-th full complementary pair; this greedy proof holds for every h. Counting allowed adjacent transitions uses L=[[1,0],[1,1]], R=[[1,1],[0,1]], e=(1,1), and the Thue–Morse identity T_{m+1}=T_m complement(T_m) yields P_{m+1}=(P_m J)^2. det P_m=1 and direct 2x2 multiplication give A_{m+1}=2+A_m(b+c) and D_{m+1}=D_m(A_m-D_m), with initial L. This is an induction for all m; independent brute-force absent-subsequence enumerations through m=3 and recurrence computed 3,5,12,74,2666. Source verify.py also independently implements the next-occurrence automaton. Checks do not prove the infinite result.
